name: List optional local assistants
summary: Discover the frozen, permitted local text assistant profiles and limits.
description: List the configured, permitted local text models in stable id order, with identity, licence, no-tools status and per-call limits. This is a frozen profile list, not a live host inventory or a model ranking. Listing loads nothing and consumes no inference reservation. A configured model may be refused at call time for identity/resource/server availability. Tools are optional. Use models.ask with an explicit id only if useful; no preferred model or duty to delegate.

demonstrations.title: Read a frozen profile list without inference
demonstrations.explanation: Builder uses a labelled fake list; Simulation returns the configured allowlist without contacting or loading a model.

limitations: Optional bounded text assistance, not an autonomous inhabitant or trusted advice.
Configured profile order is stable by id and conveys no preference or quality ranking.
Only the supplied prompt is shared. No tools, history, media inputs or host access.
Memory admission is cooperative; model servers remain outside sandbox/job hard limits.
models.ask failures, empty outputs and uncertain calls consume reservations; no retry or substitute.

failure_modes.condition: Server unavailable, timeout, identity mismatch or oversize output.
failure_modes.recovery: Treat the missing answer as missing evidence.
